entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muhammad ibn Falah was an Iraqi-born theologian who founded the Musha'sha'iya, a Shi'a sect. He received his theological education in the city of al-Hillah, and there came to believe himself to be the earthly representative of Imam Ali and the Mahdi. He was later denounced as a Kafir (non-muslim) by the Muslim establishment.
